sources.title: NOAA Science On a Sphere installation guidance
sources.relevance: Opaque indoor reference architecture, stable projector geometry and ambient-light limits.
sources.limitations: Reference geometry is not approval of a 3.4 m transparent moving outdoor sphere.

sources.title: NOAA Science On a Sphere alignment manual
sources.relevance: Coarse physical alignment before fine warp calibration.
sources.limitations: Apply the sequence as a planning pattern; our actual optics remain unmeasured.

sources.title: Rosco Guide to Projection Screens
sources.relevance: Reflective/transmissive surfaces, ambient light, seams and handling.
sources.limitations: 2018 theatrical flat-screen guide; no certification of curved inflatable material.

sources.title: Ishikawa Laboratory VarioLight2
sources.relevance: High-speed sphere tracking, orientation ambiguity and occlusion recovery.
sources.limitations: Laboratory result; all-around extension discussed as future work. Video reuse requires permission.

sources.title: Christie Mystique Pro Venue Edition
sources.relevance: Camera-assisted projector calibration on flat and curved surfaces.
sources.limitations: Vendor capability description, not proof of live human capture or our sphere performance.

sources.title: Tempest Sheraton Waikiki case study
sources.relevance: Coastal projector enclosure and environmental management precedent.
sources.limitations: Manufacturer case study, not independent qualification or a selected product.

sources.title: Tempest Burning Man case study
sources.relevance: Dust, heat and condensation protection precedent.
sources.limitations: Desert experience does not establish coastal suitability.

sources.title: NEMA Enclosure Types historical handout
sources.relevance: Distinguishes corrosion/splash and immersion enclosure categories.
sources.limitations: Approved November 2005, file metadata 2008; definitions refer to NEMA 250-2003. Historical reference, not current full standard.

sources.title: NEMA publisher store: EN 10250-2024
sources.relevance: Published edition and scope, including internal condensation and heat exclusions.
sources.limitations: Store marks 2024 most recent in accessed page. Licensed standard not acquired or reviewed.

sources.title: ESTA published standards catalogue
sources.relevance: E1.21-2024, E1.43-2025, E1.53-2025 and E1.56-2026 edition/scope screening.
sources.limitations: Direct web fetch failed. Indexed primary catalogue only; full clauses and actual project applicability unreviewed.

sources.title: RAM general body-builder design reference
sources.relevance: Manufacturer upfitter reference to inform identification work.
sources.limitations: 2022 general reference is not exact 2021 VIN, receiver or under-bed attachment documentation.

sources.title: Andersen 3200 rail-mount installation manual
sources.relevance: Example of model-specific manufacturer documentation.
sources.limitations: 2018 3200 rail-mount reference; user hitch model not identified. Not used to infer any load rating.

sources.title: CPSC water-walking ball warning
sources.relevance: Escape, suffocation and drowning concerns relevant to the sealed occupied concept.
sources.limitations: 2011 warning; supports existing v3 stop gate, not a ban on dry unoccupied sculpture.

sources.title: NASA drag of a sphere
sources.relevance: Drag relationship and coefficient dependence on flow and surface.
sources.limitations: Educational physics reference, not a design coefficient or operational wind limit.

sources.title: City of Miami special-event permit process
sources.relevance: Temporary structures can require additional building permission.
sources.limitations: Final applicability depends on exact installation and host event arrangements.

sources.title: Miami-Dade Class I permit guidance
sources.relevance: Screen work in, on, over or upon tidal waters and coastal wetlands; other agencies may apply.
sources.limitations: Exceptions and actual location/activity require agency determination; no permit conclusion made.

sources.title: FDEP Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve Management Plan
sources.relevance: Ecology, Virginia Key context, management and submerged-land regulatory references.
sources.limitations: 2025 plan; does not establish the project's actual parcel or grant placement.

sources.title: FDEP Biscayne Bay resource management
sources.relevance: Avoidance/minimization of habitat impacts and resource review.
sources.limitations: Agency context, not project-specific approval.

sources.title: NOAA Virginia Key station 8723214
sources.relevance: Local source for observed water levels and wind.
sources.limitations: No current reading or event forecast used; datum, timezone and local exposure remain necessary.

sources.title: Love Burn survival guide
sources.relevance: Beach wind, event logistics and public operation context.
sources.limitations: Generic event advice is not engineering capacity or permission to install in water.

sources.title: NWS outdoor lightning guidance
sources.relevance: Suitable shelter and at least 30 minutes after last thunder before return.
sources.limitations: Site-specific shelter access and operating authority still need a crew plan.

sources.title: OSHA grounding requirements for portable generators
sources.relevance: Grounding/bonding depends on the actual generator connection arrangement.
sources.limitations: Two-page PDF read through web tool; local HEAD returned 403, no local copy. Not a wiring design.

sources.title: OSHA 1910.305 wiring methods
sources.relevance: Electrical/wet-location reference for electrician review.
sources.limitations: Does not settle jurisdiction or installation compliance.

sources.title: NASA Enceladus overview
sources.relevance: Ocean, ice, plume and habitability science narrative.
sources.limitations: Scientific interpretation and observed data should remain distinguishable.

sources.title: NASA/APL Enceladus Orbilander mission concept study
sources.relevance: Science traceability and mission-concept context.
sources.limitations: 2020 study for 2023-2032 decadal survey; website path 2023 is not the study date. No approved mission claim.

sources.title: JPL Cassini data reveals phosphorus in Enceladus ocean
sources.relevance: 2023 phosphate discovery and distinction between life ingredients and detected life.
sources.limitations: No life detection claimed.

sources.title: USGS Enceladus Cassini global mosaic, Schenk 2024
sources.relevance: Real map candidate to fill the package's missing observational texture.
sources.limitations: Landing-page web fetch refused; TIFF HEAD returned 200 and size only. Not downloaded, decoded or hash-verified.

sources.title: US Access Board accessible routes guide
sources.relevance: Firm/stable route and accessible experience planning reference.
sources.limitations: Final temporary-site applicability and compliance not determined.

sources.title: Christie Mystique user manual download attempt
sources.relevance: Candidate technical manual for later calibration design.
sources.limitations: Direct GET returned HTTP 403. No local copy; no claim of manual review. E05 supports the general product description.

sources.title: NEMA Standards Action, May 2026
sources.relevance: Lists EN 10250-2026 in ballot/comment activity.
sources.limitations: A ballot listing is not publication proof and does not supersede the accessed publisher's published-edition record.
